prompt: Round 3 of 6. The researcher side proposes (We want university ownership with an option to licence so the researcher's analytical know-how and prior publication

content.text:
The researcher wants uni_owns_option_to_licence instead of company ownership. I need to counter - I want company ownership for direct process use. I can accept uni_owns_option_to_assign as a compromise (company gets option to take over), or push back on IP while giving on review days.

Let me counter: accept 30-day review (give) but push back on IP - propose company_owns_uni_academic_use instead. That's my main need - results I can use in products without licensing risk.
